text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from buying training 
equipment together with Still in Love—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's quite lively here, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: The lottery...
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received a raffle ticket with my 
purchase earlier. I wondered if she might 
be interested, but—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, is there anything in there... 
that catches your eye?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Browsing the lineup just for fun, assuming 
I'll give the prize to her anyway. The one 
that catches my eye after all is—
choice_data_list:
If it were me... I'd pick the "Hot Springs 
Trip Ticket."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I shall take on the 
challenge... No, I WANT to try!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, sir. I'd like to draw a 
lottery ticket once, please.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up, step right 
up! Come on now, who's up for the 
challenge~!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um...
choice_data_list: Excuse me, I'd like to try the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, comin' right up! Is the little 
miss here gonna give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... Please take care of it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love courageously turned the 
lever on the raffle machine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Kya...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, little lady! That was one 
heck of an intimidating presence out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
You must've really wanted to go to the hot 
springs, huh. Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san. Regarding this ticket...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love almost certainly intends to 
give it to me. But the one who needs to 
refresh the most is—
choice_data_list: You should be the one to use that ticket.
You should be the one to use that ticket.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-But, I...
choice_data_list:
It's a good time to rest right now, so go 
take a break.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I really do... want you to go to the 
hot springs."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I believe I was able to win it because I 
wished... that I could grant Trainer's 
wish.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That's why this ticket is for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I understand... your feelings, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... how about I join you as well?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Wouldn't it be best if... we looked 
out for each other and got some proper 
rest...?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Y-You don't have to give me an answer 
right now! For now... it's fine...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Once things settle down a bit... I'll 
invite you again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love smiled shyly. That casual 
sight... somehow felt deeply 
heartbreaking.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Special-Grade Carrot Hamburg Steak...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, but the grand prize is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Would you be happy with a 
hamburger steak too?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ... Then that's fine...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let's enjoy it as soon as we get back. I 
am quite curious about the taste as well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—It's extremely hot, so please be 
careful.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haff... haff... Nnh, aaah... It's simply 
melting on my tongue...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The juicy hamburg steak seemed to suit her 
taste... as she took her time eating every 
bite.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Incredible... What a massive amount...!
choice_data_list: That really is a massive heap...
That really is a massive heap...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What should I do? I wonder if I can use it 
all up...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know. Shall we hand these out to 
everyone at the academy?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it's carrots, most people would enjoy 
them, after all...
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Then I will distribute them on my end.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Um... Here, please have a carrot...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll leave it here. Please make sure 
to enjoy it."

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Huh? There's a carrot here!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
You're right! And look, each one has a 
different ribbon tied around it...! So 
cute...! Is this—

text_block_list.name: Classmates A & B
text_block_list.text: A fairy?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, when I passed by the 
field with Still in Love... we found some 
Umamusume with their hands clasped in 
prayer at the carrot patch.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Carrot Fairy, thank you for watching over 
me again today! Thanks to you, I made it 
through class safely!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Carrot Fairy, please... Give me the 
courage to confess my feelings to the one 
I love...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Well...?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Only one stick, huh.
choice_data_list: Go ahead and eat it, Still.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh... But this lottery is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...That's right.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: How about we split it in half?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"If sharing it with you makes it 
smaller... I'm sure I will cherish it all 
the more."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cut in half, the carrot was now small. Yet 
looking at it, Still in Love appeared 
somehow genuinely pleased.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... I am so sorry... I missed the mark...
choice_data_list: Well, that's just how these things are.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer... To you, I...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: P-Please really don't worry about it...
P-Please really don't worry about it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean anything serious by it, but 
Still in Love seemed completely earnest. 
She ended up terribly dejected...
